svg.title: Circle centering template
svg.desc: Crosshairs, diagonals and concentric scored circles locate the centre of round work up to 80 mm diameter.
svg.metadata: {"attribution":"Technology Commons teaching materials by Andrew Andrade and contributors","category":"jigs-gauges","description":"Crosshairs, diagonals and concentric scored circles locate the centre of round work up to 80 mm diameter.","dimensional_tests":{"centre_hole_diameter_mm":4,"largest_reference_diameter_mm":80},"dimensions":{"height":110,"width":160},"editors":["Inkscape","Veccy","Vectorpea"],"files":{"preview":"generated/previews/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-centering-template.svg","svg":"generated/svg/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-centering-template.svg"},"fit_type":"none","generator":{"name":"technology-commons-laser-generator","version":"0.1.0"},"id":"tc-jig-centering-template","kerf_assumptions":{"clearance_mm":0.15,"kerf_mm":0.15,"warning":"Starting values only; select from a physical calibration cut."},"license":"CC-BY-SA-4.0","material":{"measured_thickness_mm":6.0,"name":"Baltic birch plywood","nominal":"1/4 inch","warning":"Measure every sheet; nominal 1/4 inch plywood is not necessarily 6.35 mm."},"notes":"Use the scored references to align the work, then mark through the 4 mm centre hole.","operations":["CUT","SCORE","ENGRAVE"],"parameters":{"centre_hole_mm":4,"reference_diameters_mm":[20,40,60,80]},"review_status":"unverified","sensitivity":"none","shop":"general","skill_level":"introductory","source_reference":"Original procedural geometry; no traced or copied commercial artwork.","subcategory":"centering","tags":["centering","gauge","jig","template"],"title":"Circle centering template","tool_family":"centering","trademark_status":"original-generic","units":"mm"}
